previous_statement: Terminological bridge fixed by the target shard: the given C^1 manifold is regarded as a Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead manifold of class one, and its class-one atlas consists of allowable coordinate systems. Consequently, when node 1.1.1 is applied to this atlas, its chart domains are precisely domains of allowable coordinate systems.
new_statement: Conditional bridge only: if an atlas A on M consists of coordinate systems that are allowable in the Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead sense, then every chart domain occurring in A is the domain of an allowable coordinate system. The registered inputs do not establish that an arbitrary modern C^1 manifold admits such an atlas, so they do not supply the unconditional bridge required by node 1.1.
